'''Virtual Set D''' is the Players Committee virtual defensive-shield set. It launched with [[Virtual Set 0]] on 24 September 2014 (the 2014 Reset). Later virtual sets add or change shields here instead of giving them a new set number, which is why Set D does not appear as its own GEMP expansion.

These are not Decipher cards. Printable slips are published with each update.
